# 15. Limits

What this BASIC can and cannot do, and how fast it is. The error
messages are in chapter 6 (6.5).

#### `LIMITS`

Things that differ from a BBC Micro in this version:

Typed lines: 238 characters (78 with *EDIT C64); programs sent from a PC (see REMOTE) may have lines up to 251 characters. Graphics: points, lines, triangles, rectangles, parallelograms, circles, ellipses, pattern fills, flood fill, arcs, segments, sectors. Sound: SOUND and ENVELOPE as on a BBC Micro. LOAD and SAVE work between PAGE (&1D00, or &900 with *SOUND NONE) and &7FFF. Two files open at a time. *KEY, *EXEC and *SPOOL are not there yet.
